title: Rename User-Facing Gate Language to "Reflection Time"
summary: Adopts a dual-register naming convention for epistemic gates: 'epistemic gate' remains the precise research/design term used in the domain model, essays, ADRs, and system design, while 'reflection time' is the user-facing term used in skill file text spoken to the user, the README, manifesto, and orientation document. Reflection time IS the epistemic gate, renamed for the audience that experiences it; because the term alone risks under-signaling Invariant 1's generative requirement, skill file authors must pair every instance of 'reflection time' with an immediate generative prompt from the AID cycle (ADR-040).
workflow_point: user-facing gate language, all RDD phases
mechanism: dual-register terminology: 'epistemic gate' (research/design) paired with 'reflection time' (user-facing), documented as an alias

links.note: the user-facing 'reflection time' pause is paired with the adaptive prompt supplied by ADR-040's AID cycle; the term names the pause, the AID cycle supplies the generative requirement.
